name: Recognise microorganism terminology
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Match a biological description to a microorganism term, group or associated process; this is terminology recognition, not an explanation of a mechanism. [sources: biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row1, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row2, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row3, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row6, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row7, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row8, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row9, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.1.row10, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row1, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row2, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row3, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row4, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row5, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row6, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row7, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row8, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row9, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q1.row10, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.3.1, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.1]

name: Identify the independent variable of an investigation
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Identify the factor varied or compared in the stated investigation rather than the measured response. [sources: biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.1.2.a, biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q2.1, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.2]
subject: biology

name: Identify the measured response of an investigation
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Name the dependent variable from the investigation description, distinguishing the measurement from what is varied. [sources: biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.1.2.b, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.5]
subject: biology

name: Specify controls that keep comparisons fair
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Name relevant quantities or participant characteristics held the same between compared groups; do not confuse controlled variables with an untreated control group. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.A, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q3.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.1.2.c, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.3, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.6, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.4]
subject: biology

name: Apply water balance to urine volume and concentration
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Use changed water intake or loss to predict urine concentration and, where asked, volume. This is an application task rather than recall of the definition of excretion. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q1.3.4.A, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.2.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q1.4.5]
subject: biology

name: Explain osteoarthritis through cartilage damage
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Describe cartilage deterioration and its consequences at a joint; do not substitute the name of a disease for its mechanism. [sources: biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q3.2.7, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q2.2.5]
subject: biology

name: Distinguish controllable and uncontrollable circulatory risk factors
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Respond to the requested controllability category in the hypertension or coronary-disease context, rather than supplying an undifferentiated list of risks. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
subject: biology

name: Link oxygen delivery to cellular energy demands
definition: [Tier 2 derived] Explain the consequence of altered oxygen delivery or demand using respiration/energy, in the malaria and exercise contexts. Not a terminology-recall family. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
subject: biology

name: State a conclusion from a biological comparison
definition: [Tier 2 derived] State the relationship supported by the supplied group or age data rather than restating an isolated measurement. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
subject: biology
